description: This file defines the RouteProviderInterface interface for Drupal's routing system, specifying methods for retrieving and managing route collections based on requests, names, patterns, and aliases.

classes.name: RouteProviderInterface
classes.description: Defines the interface for route providers in Drupal, including methods for fetching routes by request, name, pattern, and aliases, as well as resetting the provider.

methods.name: getRouteCollectionForRequest
methods.description: Finds routes that may potentially match the given request.

methods.name: getRouteByName
methods.description: Finds a route by its name.

methods.name: getRoutesByNames
methods.description: Finds multiple routes by their names, with optional null parameter to retrieve all routes.

methods.name: getRoutesByPattern
methods.description: Retrieves routes matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: getAllRoutes
methods.description: Returns all routes in the system.

methods.name: getRouteAliases
methods.description: Gets aliases for a given route name.
